title: 1429: Should show the confirm dialog before removing participant

comments_data.body: > Excellent. I think our previous pop-up works well: ![Are you sure delete](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/85491794/159988527-3b527cca-8864-4690-81f7-596f2b0ec2c4.png) The text here would thus be "Delete Permission Are you sure you want to permanently delete this permission?" It would be ideal to also have the pop-up show the name of the user whose permission is being deleted, to emphasize the feature. Something like this: ![Delete Permission](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/85491794/159989835-22439c16-d39f-41da-9211-87c8a51b213e.png)

Thanks for moving this forward guys.

We need to called it a "participation" rather than a "permission".  It describes how a role (or group of roles) participate in a channel.  Can you rename the dialog please @lebaphi ?
> Looks great! If you could change Permission to Participation like Ian said, and deploy it, that'd be good for me.

I just checked deployment and it looks like you might have accidentally edited the Platform pop-up instead of the Participation one: 

![Permission Platform Bug](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/85491794/160180428-ee6a2c04-260f-4272-b0f3-cd59f47b041d.png)
I've updated @ShendMikullovci @IanMayo

Just checked the deployment. The feature is functional. 
A couple of things: 

1. It'd be nice to have the same format of pop-up throughout the screens. Both pop-ups dim the background and are centered in the screen to attract maximum attention. I have a small preference over the navy blue pop-up (platform one), though the delete button is less visible there. What do you guys prefer?
2. In the white pop-up, the affirmative button (yes/delete) should be placed on the right and the cancel/no button on the left.
I prefer the first popup, it looks neat and has a bit of a professional 😄 How to you think @IanMayo ?

> @ShendMikullovci is right that the buttons are less clear on the darker popup .
> 
> A good _quick fix_ is for us to standardize on the lighter popup (with the white background on the central area).
> 
> Let's do that, please @lebaphi

Excellent. We should stick to "Cancel" (left) and "Delete" (right) instead of yes/no for the buttons. Have the delete button in navy blue and the cancel button in grey as usual.
Just checked this. Works great! Thanks guys!

issues.title: "Are You Sure" pop-up Permissions
issues.body:
![Physical Proximity Edit Pen Garbage Bin](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/85491794/158646238-62205a57-1f72-4b38-8c8a-40f3ec8907b3.png)

Considering the physical proximity of the edit pen to the garbage bin, we should add an "Are you sure you want to permanently delete this role?" pop-up when clicking on the garbage bin.

I've already accidentally deleted a force trying to edit it.
